# Activity 1: Write Two Functions
- past_tense(verb)
```{python}
def past_tense(verb):

    return past_tense
```

- ttr(words)
```{python}
def ttr(words):
    ttr = len(set(words)) / len(words)
    return ttr

test = ["the", "cat", "saw", "the", "dog"]  # test list to use ttr(words) on
```

# Two Parameters
- goal is to compare the _same number_ of words
- default value for number of words is 10,000
```{python}
def ttr_first(words, n=10000):
    return len(set(words[:n])) / len(words[:n])
```

# Activity 2: Average Word Length
```{python}
def avg_word_len(words):
    wd_len_total = 0
    for w in words:
        wd_len_total += len(w)
    return wd_len_total / len(words)
```


# Simplifying Detective Gutenberg
## Activity 3: load_words()
```{python}
import re

def load_words(filename):
    try:
        with open("../../../data/gutenberg/" + filename, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print("Couldn't find a file — check the filename and location.")
    
    while not lines[0].startswith("*** START"):
        lines = lines[1:]     # chop off the first line
    lines = lines[1:]         # chop off the *** START line itself
    
    while not lines[-1].startswith("*** END"):
        lines = lines[:-1]    # chop off the last line
    lines = lines[:-1]        # chop off the *** END line itself
    
    text = "".join(lines)
    
    ## cleaning and splitting
    words = re.split(r"[\W]+", text.lower())
    words = [w for w in words if w != ""]
```

## One report per book
```{python}
def report(title, words):
    ttr = len(set(words)) / len(words)
    ttr_10000 = len(set(words[:10000])) / len(words[:10000])

    letters = 0
    for w in words:
        letters += len(w)

    print(title, "TTR:", ttr)
    print(title, "TTR (10,000 words):", ttr_10000)
    print(title, "Average Word Length:", letters / len(words))
    return ttr_10000

alice_ttr_10000 = report("Alice", load_words("alice.txt"))
mansfield_ttr_10000 = report("Mansfield Park", load_words("mansfield_park.txt"))
odyssey_ttr_10000 = report("The Odyssey", load_words("odyssey.txt"))

plt.bar(["Lewis Carroll", "Jane Austen", "Homer (tr. Butler)"], [alice_ttr_10000, mansfield_ttr_10000, odyssey_ttr_10000])
plt.title("TTR Comparison: Alice vs Mansfield Park vs The Odyssey")
plt.xlabel("Author")
plt.ylabel("TTR")
plt.show()
```
